recent.text: Joel Embiid with two incredible recovery blocks at the rim on Wendell Carter. That is the weakness with Carter. The explosion is not always there -- even though he is playing way more above the rim this year. #Magic are in a bit of danger here. PHI 62:69 ORL 0:07.9 2nd
